edits.value_json: Oracle-bone 火 in 合集 11503 is glossed as 火星, without specifying 心宿二 or the planet Mars. The inspected 火 and 晶 entries identify 火星 here as the historical name for 大火/心宿二. Why the star was called 火, and how that name relates to literal ‘fire’, are not established.
